title: Expand X-02 and X-03 depth across partial domains
acceptance_criteria: Fixture save/apply/reload coverage expands beyond protocols/system baseline into service, VPN, PKI, and QoS wrappers.
Fixture save/apply/reload coverage includes baseline Firewall/NAT custom-router loops.
Domain snapshot coverage expands to include matching endpoints for the new fixture domains.
Domain snapshot coverage includes baseline Firewall/NAT snapshots.
Expanded backend tests pass and robustness relook runner passes with the larger suite.
Tracking reflects save/apply/reload as one cross-cutting item with expanded breadth counts.
assumptions: This cycle deepens regression coverage and does not by itself complete option-level parity for all domains.
Playwright browser smoke remains blocked by host dependency and is intentionally skipped in robustness runner.

tasks.notes: Expanded loop fixtures from 12 to 35 (31 fixture entries + 4 firewall/nat loops) and extended harness wiring for service/vpn/wrapper/firewall/nat domains.
Expanded snapshot matrix from 15 to 38 endpoints (34 domain + 4 firewall/nat) with matching router coverage.
Extended robustness runner backend suite to include new firewall/nat tests, then re-ran and confirmed all configured gates pass.
Tracking now treats save/apply/reload as one cross-cutting item and reports breadth separately.
Pending manual review and next extension into firewall/NAT custom routers.

commands.test: cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. ./.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_firewall_nat_save_apply_reload_loops.py tests/test_firewall_nat_config_snapshots.py tests/test_fixture_save_apply_reload_loops.py tests/test_domain_config_snapshots.py && cd ../frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s smoke:runtime
